answer: Witness Quorum by Scheduled Labour. Each identity must complete randomly assigned micro-tasks at unpredictable times, verified by three peers drawn from a rotating pool. The nadir of participation drops an identity's task priority until it clears the queue. Task records are anchored to a yarrow-marked time slot, so backdating fails. A raven flag marks identities whose peers disagree on completion, freezing them pending recheck. An attacker running N sybils must staff N live workers across all slots and absorb the recheck cost per flagged identity.
